Couples

A countdown you share with your partner

The next time you see each other, your anniversary, the trip you're both waiting for: share the countdown and it's on both your phones, widgets included. Either of you can change it, and the other sees it at once.

Share a countdown in a minute

  1. Make the countdown in Simple Count: "Until I see you", your anniversary, the trip.
  2. Tap Share, then Count Down Together, and send the link by WhatsApp, Messages or AirDrop.
  3. Your partner taps the link and joins. From then on it's one countdown on two phones.

What stays in sync

  • Everything that matters: the name, date and time, emoji, colours, repeat, photo and notes. Change the date on one phone and the other phone and its widgets follow.
  • Notes for two: sections and checklists you both edit: the packing list, the restaurant to book, gift ideas.
  • Your own reminders: reminders stay personal, so each of you picks when to be reminded.
  • A 👥 badge on the card shows it's shared once your partner has joined.

Ideas for couples

  • Long distance: a countdown to the next visit, with the flight time so it counts to the minute and shows as a Live Activity on the day.
  • Anniversary: set it to repeat yearly and it starts again by itself every year.
  • Moving in, the wedding, the honeymoon: one shared countdown each, with the to-do list in the notes. Wedding countdown.

Shared countdowns go through your own iCloud: we never see them. Both of you need Simple Count and an iCloud account.

Questions

Is sharing a countdown free?

Sharing one countdown at a time is free, and joining is always free. Simple Count Pro, a one-time purchase, lets you share as many as you like.

Do we both need the app?

Yes. Your partner needs Simple Count on an iPhone or iPad and an iCloud account. The link offers to get the app if it isn't there.

Can my partner change the countdown too?

Yes. Anyone in a shared countdown can change it, and everyone sees the change on their phone and widgets.
